transitive_producer_obligations.statement: Derive every accepted instruction action and its source-shaped next view, including COPY and LOG0, along the actual completed runtime execution.
transitive_producer_obligations.dependencies: Actual Z/StepOk and fixed pinned runtime sites; local stack, memory, storage, log and decoding adapters. No global static permission or assumed action list.

transitive_producer_obligations.statement: Derive every intermediate and terminal memory capacity from initial gas plus memory cost.
transitive_producer_obligations.dependencies: RuntimeMemoryFunding.accepted_energy/runs_energy and threshold energy(entry)<cost(cap+1); host32cap bound. Protocol must produce the initial grant and admissible host representation. The same capacity bounds actual COPY/LOG operand lengths and thus their per-step source price; no source offset or final-capacity premise was added to the public receipt consumer.
transitive_producer_obligations.owner: root; Faraday energy proof independently reviewed by root

transitive_producer_obligations.statement: Preserve the same actual completed trace through Xi and Theta, full success tuple, REVERT internal observations and enclosing journal restoration.
transitive_producer_obligations.consumer: ReferenceRuntimeReceipt.guarantees -> all three actual guarantee predicates
transitive_producer_obligations.dependencies: Actual returned receipt; PinnedCall supplies installed owner via value transfer. STOP/RETURN derive nonempty world, eliminating the settlement fallback. False returns split into actual REVERT or exceptional error, preserving gas/output. Evaluator OutOfFuel remains an error.

transitive_producer_obligations.statement: Construct source transaction/block/prestate storage layers, access set, environment, initial output and checked values for the actual admitted frame.
transitive_producer_obligations.dependencies: Current-slot relation still supplied, parent/original/created and warm bindings separately supplied for payment. Full source bodies and exact ethereum-types0.4.1 archive verified, gas Uint unbounded nonnegative. Views are not executable Python refinement. Complete certificates retain terminal-entry warmth; final source-post warmth and rollback into outer frames require transport at their consumer.

transitive_producer_obligations.statement: Construct exact source-formula readings, prices and complete conditional payment certificate for every successful/reverted runtime; then derive actual protocol source grants and exceptional/outer resource semantics.
transitive_producer_obligations.dependencies: Same actual trace yields source events through terminal. Literal source transaction allocation and reservoir-first execution spill pay them under execution-cap/total-gas inequalities. Separate positive state-reservoir premise removed; credits used only at executed instruction. Quantified txGas/intrinsic are hypothetical sufficient allocations, not bound to the actual outer transaction or child call. Actual admitted allocation/recursive call grants, source interpreter interpretation, exceptions and settlement-to-block-history transport remain open.
transitive_producer_obligations.owner: root global/source gas integration; Faraday independent review
